exact_check_summary.A_star_vertical_fiber_exhaustion: all vertical involutions exhaustively enumerated for 1 through 6 two-element fibers; fixed-point-free case unique and equals deck

freeze_statement: All statements above are frozen before any classical Euclidean comparison. Any post-comparison repair is NEW_GENERATION_FOR_LATER_TASK.

theorems_and_counterexamples.proof_core: Terms are typed by the declared signature. An absent codomain cannot be the type of a native term; external encodings are additional readouts.
theorems_and_counterexamples.statement: In a signature with no scalar/codomain sort and no scalarization operator, a scalar-valued pi-role is not well-typed.

theorems_and_counterexamples.proof_core: S2 contains only field/vector/torsor laws. Any selection by length, angle, valuation, turning, spectrum, or refinement introduces symbols/dependencies absent from S2.
theorems_and_counterexamples.statement: The existence of a scalar field sort in S2 does not by itself provide a role predicate selecting a distinguished pi-like scalar.

theorems_and_counterexamples.proof_core: s^k has order dividing two iff 2k=0 mod m. Besides k=0, the congruence has the unique solution k=m/2 exactly when m is even.
theorems_and_counterexamples.statement: For a finite cyclic group <s> of order m, there is a unique nonidentity involution iff m is even, namely s^(m/2).

theorems_and_counterexamples.proof_core: Each fiber has exactly two elements, so each d has exactly one other fiber mate. Swapping every pair defines an involution; any fixed-point-free vertical involution must make the same pointwise choice.
theorems_and_counterexamples.statement: Every exact two-sheet map q:D->U has a unique fixed-point-free vertical involution delta_q.

theorems_and_counterexamples.proof_core: M1_S3_ACTION_MOVES_BASE is an explicit finite S3 model in which the deck map fixes UDir and flips the sheet bit, while rho(z) moves UDir and fixes the sheet bit.
theorems_and_counterexamples.statement: S3 does not force R2_DIRECTION_DECK = R3_GROUP_INVOLUTION_ACTION.

theorems_and_counterexamples.proof_core: For each d, verticality places rho(z)(d) in the two-element fiber {d,delta_q(d)}; fixed-point-freeness excludes d, hence rho(z)(d)=delta_q(d).
theorems_and_counterexamples.statement: S3 + A*-VERTICALITY + A*-FIXED_POINT_FREE forces R3_GROUP_INVOLUTION_ACTION = R2_DIRECTION_DECK exactly in Sym(ODir).

theorems_and_counterexamples.proof_core: M1 satisfies fixed-point-freeness but not verticality and separates the roles. M2 satisfies verticality but not fixed-point-freeness and separates the roles.
theorems_and_counterexamples.statement: Relative to S3, neither axiom in A*_S3_DIRECTION_COHERENCE can be deleted while retaining the equality theorem.

theorems_and_counterexamples.proof_core: Every polygon ratio Per_N(C)^2/mu(C) is divided by c, and positive scalar multiplication commutes with infimum in the order completion.
theorems_and_counterexamples.statement: For R4, replacing mu by c*mu with c>0 sends J_N,mu to J_N,mu/c while leaving the S4+N reduct unchanged.

theorems_and_counterexamples.proof_core: An infinite cyclic group has exactly two generators t and t^{-1}. Kernel inversion exchanges them; quotienting by inversion leaves one generator orbit.
theorems_and_counterexamples.statement: In S6 a raw generator of ker(p) is noncanonical, while its inversion orbit is unique and invariant.
For even m and every integer refinement factor k>=1, the uniform embedding i(j)=k j from C_m into C_(km) commutes with half-cycle roles.

theorems_and_counterexamples.proof_core: Refinement embeddings compose and T-E1 gives a natural transformation by involutions. Therefore the universal property of the direct limit induces one well-defined involution.
theorems_and_counterexamples.statement: Over the directed poset of uniform boundary subdivision factors, the compatible half-cycle roles induce a unique involution on the algebraic direct limit.

theorems_and_counterexamples.proof_core: M4 subdivides one edge of an even C4 boundary to obtain odd C5; R1 exists before and is absent after.
theorems_and_counterexamples.statement: R1 is not invariant under arbitrary cellular refinement.

theorems_and_counterexamples.proof_core: Scalar roles are ill-typed in the weakest signatures; S3 has distinct same-codomain roles; S5 scalar roles vary under valuation scaling of a common weaker reduct; other roles have distinct codomains without a frozen comparison map.
theorems_and_counterexamples.statement: The frozen signature family does not force one universal scalar pi-role or equality of all frozen roles.
